title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal and file disclosure
rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI_RAW "@rx (?i)^[^?]*(?:\.%2e|%2e\.|%2e%2e)(?:/|%2f)" "id:9920001,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2021-41773 Apache path traversal',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2021-41773',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 path traversal with double encoding
rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI_RAW "@rx (?i)^[^?]*(?:%%32%65|%%32e|\.%%32|%2%65)" "id:9920002,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2021-42013 Apache double-encoded path traversal',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2021-42013',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: PHP-CGI argument injection through a soft hyphen in the query string
rule: SecRule QUERY_STRING "@rx (?i)(?:^|\+|%20)(?:%ad|\xad)[a-z]" "id:9920003,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2024-4577 PHP-CGI argument injection',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2024-4577',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Apache Log4j JNDI lookup (Log4Shell), including obfuscated forms
rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|REQUEST_HEADERS|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_COOKIES_NAMES|ARGS|ARGS_NAMES "@rx (?i)\$\{[^}]{0,15}(?:jndi|\$\{(?:lower|upper|env|sys|date):|\$\{::-)" "id:9920004,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2021-44228 Log4Shell JNDI lookup',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2021-44228',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Atlassian Confluence OGNL injection in the request path
rule: SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx \$\{" "id:9920005,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2022-26134 Confluence OGNL injection',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2022-26134',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Atlassian Confluence template injection through text-inline.vm
rule: SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx (?i)/template/aui/text-inline\.vm$" "id:9920006,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:normalizePath,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2023-22527 Confluence template injection',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2023-22527',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Apache Struts 2 OGNL injection in the Content-Type header
rule: SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Type "@rx [%$]\{" "id:9920007,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2017-5638 Struts Content-Type OGNL injection',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2017-5638',severity:'CRITICAL'"

title: Joomla 4 web services API information disclosure (public=true)
rule:
SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "@rx (?i)/api/index\.php/v1/" "id:9920008,phase:1,deny,status:403,log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:normalizePath,chain,msg:'InfraFence virtual patch: CVE-2023-23752 Joomla API information disclosure',tag:'infrafence/vpatch',tag:'CVE-2023-23752',severity:'CRITICAL'"
    SecRule &ARGS_GET:public "@gt 0" "t:none"
